title: BARIEN (5 Sizes: 3"- 4"- 5"- 6"- 8") Set of 4 Wood Furniture Legs - Square Sofa Legs, Couch Leg - Brown Mid-Century Modern Replacement Legs for Armchair Recliner Coffee Table Dresser (3")

reviews.title: 3" legs were pleasant surprise
reviews.body: Ordered these legs to replace factory plastic legs. Pleasantly surprised when opened box at the quality, color and weight of legs. All hardware made installation/assembly super easy. You will, of course, need to supply your own screwdriver. The rubber pads stick to leg bottom really well, so position carefully. The pads keep sofa from slipping and skidding when pets or kids jump on or fall against. The legs are very sturdy and stylish. There is a small space between leg and bottom of sofa when using hanger bolts, but once sofa is set upright it is not noticeable. I am VERY pleased and recommend.

features: Made of Solid Hardwood: The furniture legs are expertly crafted of high quality solid hardwood, once installed they can withstand loads up to 1800lbs. The surface is covered with a dark color moisture resistant paint for a long lifespan of furniture

Increase The Height Of Your Furniture - The sofa legs perfectly add height to your furniture so you can easily clean under cabinets or sofas. Besides, the increase in height also has a moisture-proof function for your furniture, thereby contributing to increasing their use time.
Easy to Install - Each package includes 4 wooden legs and 4 sets of hanger bolts. All accessories are complete, you just need to attach them to the interior with quite simple operations.

Floor Protector and Noise Reduction Pads - Rubber pads on the bottom of furniture feet are pre-glued to avoid scratches on the floor and reduce the noise. On the other hand, these rubber pads also have an anti-slip effect on glossy floor surfaces

Widely Application - The set of 4 furniture legs works well on couches, armchairs, sofas, cabinets. It can also be used with beds, end tables, coffee tables, wardrobes, bookcases, office furniture...It is really useful for many of your DIY projects.
